# NFA Reachable States

This notebook focuses on the set-valued transition function of an NFA.
The automaton is the blackboard example from the finite-automata lecture:
for each input prefix, the active set is the set of all states reachable
by at least one run.

```{=html}
<div class="nfa-lab">

    <div class="nfa-field">

      <input id="nfa-word-input" value="bba" spellcheck="false" inputmode="text">
    </div>
    <button class="nfa-btn" id="nfa-step">Step</button>
    <button class="nfa-btn alt" id="nfa-reset">Reset</button>
  </div>

  <div class="nfa-workspace">
    <div class="nfa-graph-panel">
      <svg class="nfa-graph" viewBox="0 0 620 360" role="img" aria-label="NFA graph">
        <defs>
          <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
            <path d="M0,0 L0,6 L8,3 z" fill="#303036"></path>
          </marker>
        </defs>

        <path class="nfa-edge" data-edge="q-b-q2" d="M103 163 C140 112, 178 91, 224 78"></path>
        <path class="nfa-edge" data-edge="q-b-q4" d="M106 197 C145 230, 177 250, 224 264"></path>
        <path class="nfa-edge" data-edge="q2-b-q1" d="M262 74 L397 74"></path>
        <path class="nfa-edge" data-edge="q1-a-q4" d="M411 101 C371 153, 323 201, 273 244"></path>
        <path class="nfa-edge" data-edge="q4-b-q5" d="M262 258 L397 258"></path>
        <path class="nfa-edge" data-edge="q4-b-q" d="M218 281 C136 333, 55 276, 69 207"></path>
        <path class="nfa-edge" data-edge="q4-a-q1" d="M268 244 C321 197, 373 145, 409 101"></path>
        <path class="nfa-edge" data-edge="q5-a-q1" d="M429 235 L429 105"></path>

        <text class="nfa-edge-label" x="148" y="246">b</text>

        <text class="nfa-edge-label" x="346" y="173">a</text>
        <text class="nfa-edge-label" x="326" y="247">b</text>
        <text class="nfa-edge-label" x="123" y="320">b</text>
        <text class="nfa-edge-label" x="374" y="203">a</text>
        <text class="nfa-edge-label" x="441" y="174">a</text>

<script>
(function () {
  const order = ["q", "q1", "q2", "q3", "q4", "q5"];
  const transitions = {
    q: { b: ["q2", "q4"] },
    q1: { a: ["q4"] },
    q2: { b: ["q1"] },
    q3: {},
    q4: { a: ["q1"], b: ["q", "q5"] },
    q5: { a: ["q1", "q3"] }
  };
  const edgeIds = {
    "q|b|q2": "q-b-q2",
    "q|b|q4": "q-b-q4",
    "q1|a|q4": "q1-a-q4",
    "q2|b|q1": "q2-b-q1",
    "q4|a|q1": "q4-a-q1",
    "q4|b|q": "q4-b-q",
    "q4|b|q5": "q4-b-q5",
    "q5|a|q1": "q5-a-q1",
    "q5|a|q3": "q5-a-q3"
  };

  const input = document.getElementById("nfa-word-input");
  const stepButton = document.getElementById("nfa-step");
  const resetButton = document.getElementById("nfa-reset");
  const track = document.getElementById("nfa-word-track");
  const activeSet = document.getElementById("nfa-active-set");
  const traceBody = document.getElementById("nfa-trace-body");
  const explanation = document.getElementById("nfa-explanation");

  let index = 0;
  let current = ["q"];
  let rows = [{ prefix: "ε", states: current }];
  let activeEdges = [];

  function sanitizeWord(value) {
    return value.toLowerCase().replace(/[^ab]/g, "");
  }

  function formatSet(states) {
    if (states.length === 0) return "∅";
    return "{" + states.join(", ") + "}";
  }

  function sortStates(states) {
    return Array.from(new Set(states)).sort((a, b) => order.indexOf(a) - order.indexOf(b));
  }

  function stepStates(states, symbol) {
    const next = [];
    const usedEdges = [];
    const dead = [];

    states.forEach((state) => {
      const targets = (transitions[state] && transitions[state][symbol]) || [];
      if (targets.length === 0) {
        dead.push(state);
      }
      targets.forEach((target) => {
        next.push(target);
        usedEdges.push(edgeIds[state + "|" + symbol + "|" + target]);
      });
    });

    return {
      states: sortStates(next),
      edges: usedEdges.filter(Boolean),
      dead
    };
  }

  function renderWord(word) {
    track.innerHTML = "";
    if (word.length === 0) {
      const empty = document.createElement("span");
      empty.className = "nfa-symbol";
      empty.textContent = "ε";
      track.appendChild(empty);
      return;
    }
    word.split("").forEach((symbol, position) => {
      const item = document.createElement("span");
      item.className = "nfa-symbol" + (position === index ? " current" : "");
      item.textContent = symbol;
      track.appendChild(item);
    });
  }

  function renderActiveSet() {
    activeSet.innerHTML = "";
    if (current.length === 0) {
      const empty = document.createElement("span");
      empty.className = "nfa-empty";
      empty.textContent = "No run is still alive.";
      activeSet.appendChild(empty);
      return;
    }
    current.forEach((state) => {
      const pill = document.createElement("span");
      pill.className = "nfa-pill";
      pill.textContent = state;
      activeSet.appendChild(pill);
    });
  }

  function renderTrace() {
    traceBody.innerHTML = "";
    rows.forEach((row) => {
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      const prefix = document.createElement("td");
      const states = document.createElement("td");
      prefix.textContent = row.prefix;
      states.textContent = formatSet(row.states);
      tr.append(prefix, states);
      traceBody.appendChild(tr);
    });
  }

  function renderGraph(deadStates) {
    document.querySelectorAll(".nfa-node").forEach((node) => {
      const id = node.getAttribute("data-node");
      node.classList.toggle("active", current.includes(id));
      node.classList.toggle("dead", deadStates.includes(id));
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".nfa-edge").forEach((edge) => {
      edge.classList.toggle("active", activeEdges.includes(edge.getAttribute("data-edge")));
    });
  }

  function render(deadStates = []) {
    const word = sanitizeWord(input.value);
    if (word !== input.value) input.value = word;
    renderWord(word);
    renderActiveSet();
    renderTrace();
    renderGraph(deadStates);
    stepButton.disabled = index >= word.length || current.length === 0;
    if (word.length === 0) {
      explanation.textContent = "The empty word consumes no symbols, so the reachable set remains {q}.";
    } else if (index >= word.length) {
      explanation.textContent = "The word has been consumed. The final reachable set is " + formatSet(current) + ".";
    }
  }

  function reset() {
    index = 0;
    current = ["q"];
    rows = [{ prefix: "ε", states: current }];
    activeEdges = [];
    explanation.textContent = "Start from the singleton set {q}.";
    render();
  }

  function step() {
    const word = sanitizeWord(input.value);
    if (index >= word.length || current.length === 0) return;
    const symbol = word[index];
    const before = current;
    const result = stepStates(before, symbol);
    index += 1;
    current = result.states;
    activeEdges = result.edges;
    rows.push({ prefix: word.slice(0, index), states: current });
    const deadText = result.dead.length
      ? " Branches in " + formatSet(result.dead) + " have no outgoing " + symbol + "-transition."
      : "";
    explanation.textContent =
      "Read " + symbol + " from " + formatSet(before) + " and collect all successors: " +
      formatSet(current) + "." + deadText;
    render(result.dead);
  }

  input.addEventListener("input", reset);
  stepButton.addEventListener("click", step);
  resetButton.addEventListener("click", reset);
  reset();
})();
</script>
```

## What To Notice

For the default word `bba`, the reachable sets are:
\[
  \{q\},\qquad
  \{q_2,q_4\},\qquad
  \{q,q_1,q_5\},\qquad
  \{q_1,q_3,q_4\}.
\]

The important point is the third step.  When the final `a` is read, the
branch currently in `q` disappears because there is no outgoing
`a`-transition from `q`; the other branches continue and their successors
are unioned together.
